verdicts.reason: The lien of Rs 126,665.55 targets only the victim's traced funds (tainted share 17.4%) within a balance of Rs 726,923.08, leaving the merchant's own funds untouched. Although the account appears to be a genuine ~3-year-old registered merchant with zero mule-linked devices, it demonstrably received Rs 224,833 in tainted inflows and still retains Rs 126,665.55 of the victim's money.
